title: leucanthemum atratum subsp. coronopifolium
intro: Leucanthemum atratum subsp. coronopifolium, commonly known as Oxeye Daisy, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as soothing digestive issues and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Leucanthemum atratum subsp. coronopifolium include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and diuretic properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and urinary issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
